latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of Video Editor AB2N — a cloud-powered video editor for quick, polished MP4 exports.
- Upload raw video (MP4, MOV, AVI, WebM, up to 500MB) and give natural-language instructions (e.g. "cut out pauses, add background music, export as 1080p MP4").
- Automated backend handles authentication, session management, and video rendering without manual setup.
- Includes support for credits tracking, current project status, and clear error feedback for issues like unsupported formats or insufficient credits.
- Designed for speed: most edits and exports complete in 1-2 minutes for short clips.
